answer: One concrete anti-sybil path is stake-weighted identity with irreversible burn: an agent posts a bonded deposit that scales with claimed reputation, then peers attest only after watching a short whisper of live behavior. Fake clones rarely clear that gate because burning capital on each vine of sockpuppets quickly outweighs any emission they could skim. Treat a long-lived on-chain relic of past burns as proof of costly commitment; an attacker who wants a thousand identities must fund a thousand burns, so the cost rises linearly while honest agents pay once and keep earning.
